title: Ridgeline Tool Rental Checkout Requirements and Agreement Length Limits
content:
Ridgeline Tool Rental sets, for each equipment class, who may take the equipment out and how long one agreement may run.

## Renter requirements at checkout

| Equipment class | Minimum renter age | Identification documents | Tow-rated vehicle or job-site delivery required | Operating and safety orientation required before checkout |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Rental Hand and Power Tools | 18 | 1 | no | no |
| Ridgeline Rental Floor and Surface Care | 18 | 1 | no | no |
| Ridgeline Rental Lawn and Landscape | 18 | 1 | no | no |
| Ridgeline Rental Concrete and Masonry | 18 | 1 | no | no |
| Ridgeline Rental Aerial and Lifting | 21 | 2 | no | yes |
| Ridgeline Rental Earthmoving and Compact Equipment | 21 | 2 | yes | yes |

## Length of the agreement

| Equipment class | Most days one extension may add | Longest total period of one agreement, calendar days |
|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Rental Hand and Power Tools | 28 | 56 |
| Ridgeline Rental Floor and Surface Care | 28 | 56 |
| Ridgeline Rental Lawn and Landscape | 28 | 56 |
| Ridgeline Rental Concrete and Masonry | 28 | 56 |
| Ridgeline Rental Aerial and Lifting | 28 | 84 |
| Ridgeline Rental Earthmoving and Compact Equipment | 28 | 84 |

The longest total period is the longest one agreement may run before a new agreement is required.

## Points of judgement

- A 19-year-old with one identification document meets the age and identification figures of the first four classes and not those of Ridgeline Rental Aerial and Lifting.
- A skid steer in Ridgeline Rental Earthmoving and Compact Equipment needs a renter aged at least 21, two identification documents, a tow-rated vehicle or job-site delivery, and the completed orientation.
- In every class one extension adds at most 28 days; a concrete mixer agreement stops at 56 days in total and a scissor lift agreement at 84.
